snapshot_policy: ONE RECORD PER ENRICHED COLUMN. Only columns that have at least one classification, sensitivity label, or business tag are written. Unenriched columns are never included. Each record is fully self-contained: column identity + data type + all timestamps + parent asset + datasource + collection hierarchy + full classification detail (name, applied_at, applied_by, source, confidence) + sensitivity labels + business tags. You can answer every question about a column from a single record.
